_comment: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF THE MARK. Logo.tsx imports this; scripts/build-icons.mjs reads the same file to emit public/favicon.svg and the PNGs. There is no second copy of the path data anywhere, so it cannot drift. Concept and rationale: DESIGN.md, 'The mark'. The caliper end-stops are the idea — without them the shape is a motion swoosh.

paths.role: caliper end-stops at the two heights

icon._comment: Favicon-only. A standalone SVG has no context to inherit, so currentColor would resolve to the UA text colour and vanish on a dark tab strip. sRGB readbacks of the design tokens.
